notes: Official Codex app-server documentation marks stdio as the default supported transport and websocket as experimental/unsupported.
The basic stdio sample proved initialize, initialized, model/list, thread/list, thread/start, turn/start, streamed notifications, and turn/completed.

Non-blocking notifications arrived while the turn was active, including configWarning, remoteControl/status/changed, mcpServer/startupStatus/updated, thread/status/changed, thread/tokenUsage/updated, and account/rateLimits/updated.
Approval request capability remains blocked because the first command-approval prompt did not emit an approval request despite approvalPolicy on-request.
The smoke runner now records child pid and exit signal; descendant process-tree orphan checks remain blocked.
